task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary with only essential information.
Write a summary of moderate length, around 60-70 words.
Write a detailed summary with extensive information.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Write longer sentences with more complex structure and multiple clauses.
Focus on presenting clear, concrete facts without speculation or opinion.
Include some interpretation or opinion alongside the facts.

axes.name: use_of_names_and_titles
axes.description: 인물 이름과 직함 사용 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use names and titles sparingly, focusing more on general information.
Use full names and titles frequently to specify subjects clearly.
